source.recipes: Hypixel Wiki, each minion's own page — the 'Obtaining' table's Total Upgrade Cost column, summed into a cumulative ladder and cross-checked against the table's own cumulative column.

note: `upgrade` is what one tier adds; `cumulative` is every material the tier has cost since Tier I, including the ones the wiki's cumulative column omits because no bazaar prices them.
